name: Obadiah
overview: Obadiah is a male biblical figure known for his reverent fear of the Lord, as noted in 1 Kings 18:3. He was entrusted by King Jehoshaphat to teach the people, highlighting his role in spiritual instruction and leadership. Scripture provides limited additional personal details beyond these attributes.
namesAndTitles: The name Obadiah means 'servant or worshiper of YHWH,' reflecting his devotion to God. This proper name emphasizes his identity as one who serves the Lord faithfully.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Obadiah beyond what is noted in his unique attributes. There are no additional relational details provided.
scriptureSignificance: Obadiah's significance lies in his faithful fear of God and his role as a teacher appointed by King Jehoshaphat, demonstrating his importance in guiding the people in truth and worship. His example illustrates the value of godly reverence and leadership within Israel during a time when such qualities were needed. Through his service, he contributed to the spiritual education and encouragement of the nation.
